_comment: Pre-made sound effects for the desk ritual (ElevenLabs eleven_text_to_sound_v2), processed into Assets/Maliang/Audio/SFX/<id>.wav. seconds = generated length; loop = seamless loop; influence = prompt_influence (default 0.5); gain_db = boost for quiet sounds. Regenerate one with: python Tools/sfx/generate_sfx.py <id>

sounds.prompt: A paper scroll with two small wooden rods unrolling across a wooden desk: soft dry paper rustle and gentle wooden rolling, close, quiet room. No music.
The soft tip of a calligraphy brush touching rice paper: one tiny soft papery tap, very close and quiet. No music.
Continuous soft calligraphy brush dragging across rice paper: a gentle, even papery swish, very close, steady, no pauses. No music.
A calligraphy brush dipped into a small stone dish of ink: a soft wet tap with a tiny liquid sound, close. No music.
A heavy stone seal pressed firmly onto paper lying on a wooden desk: a single dull, solid, satisfying thump, close. No music.
A gentle magical rising shimmer: soft airy chimes and a warm breath swelling upwards, mystical and quiet, East Asian feel. No melody, no voice.
Paper catching fire from a candle: a soft whoosh as the flame takes hold, with the first small crackles, close. No music.
A sheet of paper burning steadily: soft crackling, small pops and a gentle fluttering flame, close and continuous. No music.
A single tiny crackle pop of a burning paper ember, very short and close. No music.
A small thin wooden rod falling and clattering on a wooden table, light, short, close. No music.
Small flames on burning paper suddenly put out: a soft hiss and a little puff of smoke, close. No music.
Magic energy draining away: a low, soft, descending deflating whoosh, sad and quiet, mystical. No melody, no voice.
A scroll of paper with wooden rods dropped onto a wooden desk: a dull soft thud with a light papery slap, close. No music.
Dry burnt paper crumbling into ash: faint soft crackling rustle and sifting dust, close and quiet. No music.
A magical object materializing out of smoke and embers: a warm shimmering bloom with a soft deep resonance, mystical, East Asian feel. No melody, no voice.
Constant, steady wood-on-wood sliding friction of an antique wooden drawer gliding at an even speed, continuous and uniform, close. No knocks, no starts or stops, no music.
A wooden drawer reaching its end with a soft wooden knock, short, close. No music.
Calm open-air ambience high in misty mountains above the clouds: soft gentle wind, very distant birds and a faraway waterfall, peaceful and spacious. No music, no voices.
